units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 173b:5">B. Bath. 173ᵇ</cite> <he>בתר ע׳ אזלי</he> they (the Persian courts) go for the surety (without suing the debtor at all).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 174a:13">Ib. 174ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ דיתמי</he> a bondsman for heirs, i.e. one who had gone security for the decedent.

<cite ref="Sotah 37b:7">Sot. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ וע׳ דע׳ איכא בינייהו</he> the difference between the two opinions lies in the question whether each bondsman (for the entire people at the covenant of Sinai) was also a bondsman for the bondsman, i.e. responsible for those failing to prevent wrongdoing.

<cite ref="Gittin 28b:3">Gitt. 28ᵇ</cite> (proverbial expression) <he>עַרְבָיךְ ע׳ צריך</he> thy bondsman requires a bondsman, i.e. he on whom you rely for vigilance might be neglectful himself; <cite ref="Sukkah 26a:13">Succ. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ערביך ע׳ צריך</he> thy watchman might likewise fall asleep.
<cite ref="Shabbat 140b:12">Sabb. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>ואנא ע׳</he> and I vouch for it; a. fr.
